name: 状態フィルターとコンテンツ権限を持つメンバー管理表
prompt:
Create a wide Dropbox-style team member administration table based closely on the supplied reference crop, at roughly the same 1440:526 panoramic ratio. Exclude the page heading and left navigation. Preserve the open “More options” menu state.
Top action row: primary “Invite members” with a restrained Lighthouse gradient fill (135deg #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E), then white outlined “Manage licenses” and “Settings”, then “More options” with a neutral ellipsis icon. Show its open white dropdown directly beneath with exactly two rows: “Import CSV file” and “Export member data”, each with a neutral slate line icon.
Next row: a small search icon at far left, then status filters “Active 2”, “Suggested by Dropbox 0”, “External collaborators 1”, “Invited 0”, “Suspended 0”, “Removed 0” with a small down chevron, and “Group” with a down chevron. Keep filters white and neutrally outlined; show Active selected with a thin official Lighthouse gradient border or edge accent and no colored fill.
Below a thin neutral divider, show the member table with headers “Name” and an up sort arrow, “Role”, “Storage usage”, and “Content permissions”, plus a right-side row ellipsis action. Exactly two rows:
1) white circular avatar with neutral outline and initials “AS”; “Alex Smith”; secondary email “alexsmith@content-mobbin.com”; Role “Team admin”; storage “1.21 MB”; “Manage access” with a small neutral pencil icon; ellipsis.
2) white circular avatar with neutral outline and initials “SL”; “Sam Lee”; secondary email “samlee@content-mobbin.com”; Role “Member”; storage “0 bytes”; “Manage access” with a small neutral pencil icon; ellipsis.
Use white surfaces throughout, ink #1D1D1D, secondary text #6E6E6E, neutral icons #526173, thin light-gray dividers, compact readable spacing. Use the official gradient only on Invite members and the selected Active filter edge. No tinted panels, colored avatar fills, pastel pills, washes, glow, extra members, or added page title. Preserve the exact visible counts and open-menu contents.
reviewNotes: Reviewed v1 against the saved 1440x526 Dropbox source crop. Preserves the four top actions and open import/export menu, six status filters/counts, selected Active state, sorted Name header, both member rows, storage values and Manage access/ellipsis actions. White surfaces, neutral avatars/icons, official gradient only on Invite and selected Active edge; no tint. Static candidate review only.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
